description: Age profile of a slice of postings: median days since publication, share posted in the last week, and share still open after sixty days. A listing that has been open for months is the most commonly cited sign that a role is not being actively filled — this reports the numbers rather than guessing.

board_handle.description: Restrict to one ATS board by its handle, exactly as the `handle` field of a posting reports it, e.g. "EndeavorITSolution" (SmartRecruiters) or "walmart:wd504:WalmartExternal" (Workday). The precise way to pull one employer's postings when names are ambiguous.

city.description: City name as employers write it, e.g. "Berlin", "New York", "Bengaluru".

company.description: Restrict to one employer by name.

country.description: Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("US", "DE") or an English name ("Germany").

keywords.description: Terms mentioned anywhere in the posting — title or description — e.g. ["Kubernetes"]. Any keyword matches. Use titles for the role itself; keywords for a tool, skill or technology the posting talks about.

posted_within_days.description: Only postings published in the last N days.

salary_min.description: Lowest advertised salary to include. Only postings that disclose a salary match.

titles.description: Job titles to match, e.g. ["Data Engineer"]. Terms shorter than 3 characters are rejected by the index.

work_arrangement.description: Filter by how the work is done. Hybrid is not a separate filter upstream.

name: posting_age_report
title: How long these postings have been open
